description: Fresh EN maritime watchkeeping holdout domain with ES/EN questions.

units.title: Independent position verification
units.text: Electronic position aids are checked against approved charted references and other available observations. A single electronic device does not replace independent position verification.

units.title: Restricted visibility
units.text: When visibility deteriorates, the watch officer applies the vessel's restricted-visibility procedure, including the required speed assessment and additional lookout measures.

units.title: Compass error check
units.text: A compass error check compares an observed bearing with a known reference so the bridge team can identify the current difference between indicated and reference direction.

units.title: Watch handover
units.text: The relieving officer receives the vessel's position, course, traffic situation, equipment limitations, weather, and outstanding instructions before accepting the watch.

units.title: Bridge log
units.text: The bridge log records significant navigation events, course changes, weather observations, and operational interruptions so later review can reconstruct the watch.

units.title: Navigation alarm
units.text: A navigation alarm is investigated before it is cleared. Repeated acknowledgement without checking the underlying condition is not treated as resolution.
